captions.facebook:
FINANCIAL EDUCATION · Education edition

Why economic history is worth knowing

Economies have gone through booms and slowdowns many times.

Studying them shows that conditions change and that no phase lasts forever.

Central banks and statistical agencies publish the official records of what actually happened.

History does not predict the next event. It gives context for today's news.

Learn. Understand. Stay Informed.

#TwoMarketLedger #TMLEducation #EconomicHistory #FinancialLiteracy #FinancialLiteracy

For information and education only. Not financial advice.
